svg.text: @kolu/surface-family — the notion (NEW package)
entry spec typed ONCE · branded key folded into every proc's INPUT (one already-muxed socket)
ONE authority: entries — Collection<Key, warming | connected | failed(reason) + clockOffset>
absence = not in the collection · removal ⇒ typed END of that key's subs
client: pure entry(key) · Solid useEntry(accessor) — swap = dispose-and-rebuild, sync first value
base @kolu/surface: sub-dedup = keyed map of createSingletonRoot slots (lifetime tied to entries)
rides @kolu/surface only · serveSurfaceFamily(family, { resolve }) — resolver-backed, registry-agnostic
the UNIFICATION of two independent hand-rollings (prove-then-extract: met by archaeology)
CONSUMER 1 · KOLU (the one kolu PR)
kolu-server: serveHostFamily(buildHostRegistry)
warm ssh sessions · lazy drv faults → failed(reason)
hosts.add/remove = root RPCs writing the registry (P3)
#1708 lessons re-land clean-room (pins as checklist)
one socket (ops gate: measured)
kolu browser
canvas = useEntry(activeHost) — switch = a signal write
selector strip (drishti-like) + add/remove buttons —
gated on KOLU_PADI_HOST · chips: status + urgency LIVE
fallback policy reads entries — a value, not a callback
env seeds the pool · runtime add/remove ephemeral · no recentHosts
DEAD: activeConnectionManager · per-host sockets · pick-epoch
retire-stubbing · useBindingScopedSub/bindingScoped/reSub tower
CONSUMER 2 · DRISHTI (the paired adoption PR)
parent server: hostRegistry → serveHostFamily
agent shipped over ssh stdio · per-host sessions kept
admin hosts.add/remove/reconnect → registry writes
its hand-rolled admin-surface host plumbing: adopted away
drishti browser (fleet view — behavior parity)
fleet cards + tab strip = entries.use() (one authority)
drill-down = useEntry(selectedHost) · ?host= deep links
connection dots read EntryStatus values
acceptance = the DELETION diff + parity screenshots —
the framework proves itself by shrinking a real product
DEAD: hand-rolled hostRegistry membership glue +
admin-surface hosts collection/status plumbing
